title: Test-Time Search in Neural Graph Coarsening Procedures for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
abstract: arXiv:2510.00958v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The identification of valid inequalities, such as the rounded capacity inequalities (RCIs), is a key component of cutting plane methods for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP). While a deep learning-based separation method can learn to find high-quality cuts, our analysis reveals that the model produces fewer cuts than expected because it is insufficiently sensitive to generate a diverse set of generated subsets. This paper proposes an alternative: enhancing the performance of a trained model at inference time through a new test-time search with stochasticity. First, we introduce stochastic edge selection into the graph coarsening procedure, replacing the previously proposed greedy approach. Second, we propose the Graph Coarsening History-based Partitioning (GraphCHiP) algorithm, which leverages coarsening history to identify not only RCIs but also, for the first time, the Framed capacity inequalities (FCIs). translated_title: 面向带容量约束车辆路径问题的神经图粗化过程中的测试时搜索
translated_abstract: 有效不等式的识别（例如圆整容量不等式，RCI）是基于割平面方法求解带容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）的关键组成部分。尽管基于深度学习的分离方法可以学习找到高质量的割，但我们的分析表明，该模型产生的割数量低于预期，因为它对生成多样化的候选子集集合不够敏感。本文提出了一种替代方案：通过一种带有随机性的新型测试时搜索方法来提升已训练模型在推理阶段的性能。首先，我们在图粗化过程中引入随机边选择，取代了之前提出的贪心方法。其次，我们提出了基于图粗化历史的划分（GraphCHiP）算法，该算法利用粗化历史，不仅能识别RCI，还首次能够识别框架容量不等式（FCI）。实验……
tldr: 本文提出在推理阶段引入随机性的测试时搜索策略（随机边选择与GraphCHiP算法），利用图粗化历史显著提升深度学习模型为CVRP割平面法生成有效不等式（RCI及首次实现的FCI）的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stochastic test-time search (random edge selection and the GraphCHiP algorithm) that enhances a trained neural graph coarsening model at inference, leveraging coarsening history to identify not only rounded capacity inequalities but, for the first time, framed capacity inequalities for CVRP cutting plane methods.
